requirements.text: 4+ years building and shipping full-stack web applications in production. 5+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of shipping production systems is a plus.
Strong React skills (or equivalent modern frameworks), with deep working knowledge of TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and component-driven architecture.
Strong proficiency in Python and modern backend frameworks.

Experience designing and working with GraphQL and RESTful APIs, relational databases (PostgreSQL), and familiarity with NoSQL stores. Comfort working in microservices or service-oriented architectures.
Solid system design, coding, and testing skills on both sides of the stack.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and modern deployment practices.
Product sense and craft. You care about how things feel, not just whether they work.
Strong communicator who collaborates well across product, design, operations, and data, and can drive ambiguous problems to a clear outcome.
High agency in a fast-paced environment.
Mentorship instincts: experience growing other engineers through reviews, pairing, or technical leadership is a plus.
Strong preference for the Bay Area. Nash runs a hybrid-first product team out of our San Francisco office.
Experience with Flask, SQLAlchemy, or WebSockets.
Background in integration-heavy or real-time systems.
4+ years building and shipping full-stack web applications in production. 5+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of shipping production systems is a plus.
